On May 28, 2024, the Scroll Token contract on Ethereum Mainnet was exploited via an arithmetic flaw that enabled an attacker to withdraw 76.36 ETH. The exploit sequence involved the Universal Router and helper contracts, but direct victim-source code remains unavailable. The Scroll Token contract suffered from an arithmetic error, likely an integer underflow in its accounting logic. This enabled unauthorized withdrawals, as inferred from reproduction code and observed on-chain transfers. The exact victim contract implementation is not confirmed due to unavailable source.
